title: StarStitch: Fighting the Drowsy Millstone in my solo 2D RPG
author: SkyDazzling5875

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Hey u/SkyDazzling5875, this falls under Rule 4. Commercial posts are okay here, but you need to talk about how it was developed using AI, so the community has something to discuss. This post doesn't have enough on that yet.

To keep it up, edit your post or reply to this comment within an hour with some details on your dev process, like:

- which AI tools you used, and what for
- how they fit into your workflow
- problems you hit and how you dealt with them

"Made with AI", a list of tools or a ChatGPT bullet list won't cut it. If nothing's added by then, this post may be removed.

If you think we got this wrong, [message the mods](https://www.reddit.com/message/compose?to=/r/aigamedev).

replies.author: SkyDazzling5875
replies.body:
Sure. It's a Unity action RPG I've been working on for about two months. Claude Code do the coding, the art comes from OpenAI image gen, animation from Higgsfield video, music from Suno, and sound effects from ElevenLabs.

Animation was the hardest part. Image gen can make one good picture, but the character changes from frame to frame. So I generate a video from the art, cut it into frames and remove the background. That's also how I ended up switching from 3D to 2D three days in, because the 3D never looked like the concept art.

comments.author: playtetramental
comments.body:
This looks like fun! I like the style and animations! 

Some thoughts: the power up move animation doesn’t quite match the game style. The banner is great, but the purple animation could probably be improved by changing the direction toward the enemy and a different type of fade for the move.
